title: Linearity of derived module homology
statement: Let k be a commutative ring and choose the derived category of ModuleCat k as in [def-weil-derived-category-cohomology-functor]. For every integer n, its degree-n homology functor is k-linear.

proof.text: The short-complex functor preserves scalars componentwise. Compose it with the k-linear short-complex homology functor. Use homologyFunctorFactors as the lifting isomorphism and Localization.functor_linear_iff to descend k-linearity to the derived homology functor.

proof_origin.note: M1 second-reading repair: explicit canonical evaluation; no arbitrary equivalence is normalized.
